description:
Search within a filing's documents for specific terms. Returns matching lines with context.

If filename is omitted, searches every readable document in the filing (the main
document and its exhibits, e.g. an 8-K's press release AND its CFO commentary), up to
12 files. A filing with only XML forms (Form 144, 3/4/5, 13F, N-PORT, D) is searched as
raw XML lines, so element names (aggregateMarketValue, netAssets) match as well as values.
If filename is provided, searches only that file. Each file in the result
carries its own source (beatandraise_url) — cite the file the match came from.

Workflow:
1. Use get_filings to find the accession number for the filing you want
2. Call this tool with just accession_number and query — it will search all its documents
3. Optionally use get_filing_detail to see all files, then search a specific one by filename

Supports multiple search terms separated by commas — lines matching any term are returned.
A comma inside a number is kept: "3,007" or "464,391" is searched as one figure.

Args:
    accession_number: SEC accession number (e.g. "0001045810-25-000023")
    query: Search terms, comma-separated (e.g. "singapore,revenue" or "risk factors")
    cik: Optional. CIK of the filer (e.g. "0000320193"); found from the accession number when left out
    filename: Optional document filename. If omitted, searches all readable documents.
    context_lines: Lines of context around each match (0-50, default 10)
name: search_document
title: Search Within a Filing
